title: Animal Feeds and Feeding Stuffs - Determination of Calcium and Magnesium in Mineral Supplements
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard prescribes the EDTA method for the determination of calcium and magnesium in mineral supplements. Due to lower concentration of calcium in animal feeds and fodders and because of high organic matter content, the procedure is not suitable for feeds and fodders.
clause_3_terminology: Determination of Calcium and Magnesium in Mineral Supplements

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
